thread.title: UPDATE: Apple adds 40 points to Dow's 300-point rally after report that Buffett bought 75 million shares

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Apple adds 40 points to Dow's 300-point rally after report that Buffett bought 75 million shares
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average slashed an opening drop to trade sharply higher Friday afternoon, on the back of a pop in Apple Inc. (AAPL). Shares of Apple were contributing about 40-points to the price-weighted Dow after a report from CNBC late Thursday said Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (BRKA)(BRKA) acquired some 75 million additional shares (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/warren-buffetts-berkshire-hathaway-bought-75-million-apple-shares-in-first-quarter-2018-05-03) of the iPhone maker during the first quarter. Shares of Apple were up about 3.3%, or $5.92, contributing about 41 points to the Dow, with a $1 move in any one of the blue-chip gauge's 30 components equating to a 6.89-point swing. The Dow was recently up 260 points, or 1.1%, at 24,222. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index was up about 1.1% at 2,659, while the Nasdaq Composite Index was advancing by 1.4% at 7,188. Apple is the largest company by market value and tends to have an outsize influence on market-value weighted indexes like the Nasdaq and S&P 500.
-Mark DeCambre; 1321ET
